items.name: 1 archive SHA-256 equals the declared package digest
1b safe extraction (no absolute paths, '..', links, devices)
1c sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS in the extracted package
1d runner and harness digests equal the declared ones
2 PYTHON is an absolute executable path
2b Python is exactly 3.12.13 and NumPy exactly 2.5.1 (otherwise the run is refused)
3 job directory is an absolute path that does not exist
3b job directory parent exists and is writable
3c job directory is not inside the package or the record directory
3d at least 10 GB free on the job filesystem (measured, not inferred)
3e at least 10 GB free on the TMPDIR filesystem
4a package verifier: the frozen ARCHIVE against its recorded source commit
4b evidence verifier: the COMMITTED HISTORICAL EVIDENCE (not the package) from a pristine archive
items.detail: COMMITTED_EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY: VERIFIED | ORIGINAL_MANIFEST_ENTRIES_VS_RECORDED_ORIGINAL_DIGESTS: CONSISTENT | ORIGINAL_JOB_INTEGRITY: NOT_REVERIFIED_FROM_THIS_CHECKOUT | EVIDENCE_VERIFICATION: PASS

items.name: 5 AC power reported online (where the platform reports it)
5b host powered and awake for the whole window; sleep, hibernate and lid-close actions suspended (not detectable from WSL)
items.detail: OPERATOR CONFIRMATION REQUIRED before any launch

items.name: 6 no competing r4 job process is running
